protocol.source: verified existing full_history datasets and their original monthly partitions
protocol.repair: Rebuild the last five observed starts within 60 days; unknown outcomes excluded from win/top3/DQ rate denominators and represented by an explicit unknown fraction; stopped/fallen count as nonwins, non-top3 and non-DQ with a separate fraction. No inferred missing starts.
protocol.unchanged: Other 33 frozen sporting features retained. No individual-history enrichment extrapolated from the 34-race convenience sample. No correction claimed for missing non-PMU starts or long-memory Elo.
protocol.selection: Temperature chosen solely on 2025 log loss, separately for baseline and repaired model; no evaluation-driven tuning. Fixed single repaired candidate.

paired_week.interpretation: Exploratory paired cluster bootstrap, not corrected for model search; repeated horses can remain dependent across weeks.

limitations: Unknown non-PMU starts remain missing; no claim of complete individual histories.
Other 33 features retained, including potentially incomplete Elo/entourage histories.
2025 and 2026 previously observed; not independent validation. No odds or ROI.
